query: What was the total revenue generated today?
baseline_sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(o.OrderTotal), 0) AS total_revenue_today
FROM 
    `Order` o
WHERE 
    DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE()
    AND o.Deleted = 0
    AND o.OrderStatusId IN (10, 20, 30); -- 10=Pending, 20=Processing, 30=Complete (adjust based on your status IDs)
```
aegis_sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0) - COALESCE(o.RefundedAmount, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND (o.CreatedOnUtc >= CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) AND o.CreatedOnUtc < CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND (o.CreatedOnUtc >= CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) AND o.CreatedOnUtc < CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND o.Deleted = 0
aegis_interpretation: Total Revenue, for Today, where Order Date is today.

query: What was the gross profit margin for last month?

FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND (o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y-%m-01') - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y-%m-01'))

query: List the top 7 most frequently purchased categories this quarter.
baseline_sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.Id AS CategoryId,
    c.Name AS CategoryName,
    COUNT(oi.Id) AS PurchaseCount
FROM OrderItem oi
INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
INNER JOIN Product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
INNER JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
INNER JOIN Category c ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
WHERE 
    o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
    AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
    AND o.OrderStatusId IN (10, 20, 30) -- Pending, Processing, Complete
    AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Id, c.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC, c.Name ASC
LIMIT 7;
```
aegis_sql:
SELECT c.Name AS `Category`, COALESCE(oi.Quantity, 0) AS `Quantity Sold`
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN `Product_Category_Mapping` pcm ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
LEFT JOIN `Category` c ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND (o.CreatedOnUtc >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) + INTERVAL (QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) QUARTER AND o.CreatedOnUtc < MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) + INTERVAL (QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) QUARTER + INTERVAL 1 QUARTER)
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(oi.Quantity, 0) DESC
LIMIT 100
aegis_interpretation: Quantity Sold, broken down by Category, for This quarter, highest first, top 7.

query: Chart the number of sold units per day for the top 5 products in the last quarter.
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH last_quarter_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AS start_date,
        CURDATE() AS end_date
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT 
        p.Id AS product_id,
        p.Name AS product_name,
        SUM(oi.Quantity) AS total_sold_units
    FROM `OrderItem` oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
    INNER JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
    CROSS JOIN last_quarter_dates lqd
    WHERE o.CreatedOnUtc >= lqd.start_date
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc < lqd.end_date
        AND o.OrderStatusId IN (30, 40) -- Complete and Shipped statuses
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND p.Deleted = 0
        AND p.Published = 1
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Name
    ORDER BY total_sold_units DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc) AS sale_date,
    p.Id AS product_id,
    p.Name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.Quantity) AS units_sold
FROM `OrderItem` oi
INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
INNER JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
INNER JOIN top_products tp ON p.Id = tp.product_id
CROSS JOIN last_quarter_dates lqd
WHERE o.CreatedOnUtc >= lqd.start_date
    AND o.CreatedOnUtc < lqd.end_date
    AND o.OrderStatusId IN (30, 40)
    AND o.Deleted = 0
    AND p.Deleted = 0
    AND p.Published = 1
GROUP BY DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc), p.Id, p.Name
ORDER BY p.Id, sale_date;
```
aegis_sql:
SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(COALESCE(oi.Quantity, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND (o.CreatedOnUtc >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) + INTERVAL (QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) QUARTER - INTERVAL 1 QUARTER AND o.CreatedOnUtc < MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) + INTERVAL (QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) QUARTER)
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY p.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 5
aegis_interpretation: Quantity Sold, broken down by Product Name, for Last quarter, highest first, top 5.

query: Compare sales between Electronics and Apparel.
aegis_sql:
SELECT c.Name AS label, SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS value
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN `Product_Category_Mapping` pcm ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
LEFT JOIN `Category` c ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND (c.Name = @p0 OR c.Name = @p1)
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Name
LIMIT 100
aegis_interpretation: Product Revenue, broken down by Category, where Category is Electronics and Category is Apparel. Total Revenue is measured per order, so it cannot be attributed to an item-level breakdown without counting each order once per matching line. Using Product Revenue instead, as the semantic layer defines for this grain.

query: Contrast the average order value of first‑time buyers vs. returning customers.
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.CustomerId,
        o.Id AS OrderId,
        o.OrderTotal,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.CustomerId ORDER BY o.CreatedOnUtc) AS order_sequence
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
        AND o.OrderStatusId IN (30, 40) -- Complete and Shipped
),
first_time_orders AS (
    SELECT OrderId, OrderTotal
    FROM customer_orders
    WHERE order_sequence = 1
),
returning_orders AS (
    SELECT OrderId, OrderTotal
    FROM customer_orders
    WHERE order_sequence > 1
)
SELECT 
    'First-time Buyers' AS customer_type,
    ROUND(AVG(OrderTotal), 2) AS average_order_value,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM first_time_orders

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Returning Customers' AS customer_type,
    ROUND(AVG(OrderTotal), 2) AS average_order_value,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM returning_orders;
```
aegis_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `Order` o2 WHERE o2.CustomerId = o.CustomerId AND o2.Deleted = 0) > 1 THEN 'Returning' ELSE 'First-time' END AS label, AVG(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY label
LIMIT 100
aegis_interpretation: Average Order Value, broken down by Customer Cohort.
